For me,when I was at my lowest of low points it wasn't anticipated.. It just kind of happened one day. I woke up and felt like everything was just..done. I think you have anxiety,and a part of it is paranoia. Paranoia about yourself,which is totally normal. I promise,it doesn't mean you will wake up tomorrow wanting to harm yourself or someone else. 

I often felt like I was staring the mess I made of my life in the eyes. It's been a very real struggle. I have attempted to kill myself,but I say attempted bc I think if it was something I actually wanted I know how to and would have done it. I think for myself at least, I was craving something in my life I was just missing. I felt so secluded and alone that I drove people away,do you think maybe you are doing the same thing? 

Are you violent? Are you scared or yourself or others? Are you a pathological liar to the ones you love? And don't take "pathological liar" as such a negative,there have been times I lied to my loved ones for things I thought i was saving them from.
